source.text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status score of 0 or 1;
Patients with histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced solid tumors which have progressed on or following standard therapy or for which no standard therapy exists;
Patients with at least one measurable lesion by computed tomography (CT) or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), according to RECIST v1.1.
Known malignant central nervous system disease other than neurologically stable, treated brain metastases

History (≤5 years) or current evidence of cancer that is histologically distinct from the cancer under study, except for cervical carcinoma in situ, superficial non-invasive bladder tumors, or curatively treated Stage I non-melanoma skin cancer.

History of severe autoimmune disease (including significant ongoing immune-related adverse events of prior immune-oncology therapy) or autoimmune disorder that requires chronic systemic corticosteroid treatment at immunosuppressive doses (prednisone \>10 mg/day or equivalent);
Seropositive status for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), or hepatitis C virus (HCV) at any time before the start of treatment

History (≤6 months before the start of treatment) or evidence of any of the following: acute myocardial infarction, unstable angina pectoris, coronary artery bypass graft, cerebrovascular accident, or transient ischemic attack;
History of an allogeneic bone marrow or solid organ transplant;
Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding.
Has a history of (non-infectious) pneumonitis / interstitial lung disease that required steroids or has current pneumonitis / interstitial lung disease or radiation pneumonitis.
